candidates.change_summary: Replace return true with return false at end of function.
Replace the require statement so that it always fails when _tos length is zero, but now it requires false, making the function always revert.
Delete the return true statement so the function does not return any value, which changes the returned data and will cause decoding failures or different boolean result at the call site.
Replace return true with return false, changing the boolean value returned to the caller.
Delete the revert statement inside the if block so that failed external calls are silently ignored, allowing the function to return true even when some calls fail.
Replace the condition in the if statement from 'if (! _s)' to 'if (_s)' so it reverts on success instead of on failure.
Replace the external call's value argument from v to 0, so tokens transferred are always zero regardless of caller input.
Replace the external call's source address from the 'from' parameter to address(0), causing transfers to be attempted from the zero address.
Delete the entire loop body, so no external calls are made, and the function always returns true without performing any transfers.
Replace the for loop initialization so i starts at 1, skipping the first recipient in the array.
